title: Manifest
description: On stdout, after start and just before done, on success: what course.json declares about the course beyond its title. Each key is null when the course declares none.

kind.description: The program that printed the line.

run.description: One id per invocation, on every line it prints.

at.description: When the line was printed, UTC.

summary.description: course.json's summary, trimmed, or null when the course declares none.

author.description: course.json's author, trimmed, or null when the course declares none.

license.description: course.json's license, an SPDX license expression as declared (trimmed), or null when the course declares none.

format.description: The course format course.json declares, or null when it declares none. School plays only the format it was built for, so a course that loads has none or that one.
